_about: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in what you need (or run ./install.sh to generate it). All fields are optional; unset fields degrade gracefully. | 复制本文件为 config.local.json 并填写所需字段（或运行 ./install.sh 自动生成）。所有字段均为可选，留空时相应功能自动降级。
_sources: Enabled observation sources (also Skill targets): claude_code | cursor | codex. Empty = auto-detect all available. Configure via `python -m distiller.setup` or the Dashboard Settings. | 启用的观察源（同时作为 Skill 应用目标）。空数组表示自动探测所有可用平台。
_sinks: Enabled delivery channels: feishu | local | slack. Empty = auto (Feishu if available, otherwise local). | 启用的通知渠道。空数组表示自动选择（飞书可用则用飞书，否则回退至本地）。
_skill_target: Default target platform for the Dashboard 'Apply to production' (claude_code / cursor / codex). Empty = first writable enabled platform. | Skill 的应用目标平台。留空时自动选择首个可写的启用平台。
_slack_webhook: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...). Required to enable the slack channel; empty = Slack skipped. | 启用 slack 渠道时必填；留空则跳过 Slack。
_cursor_rules_dir: Cursor Skill (.mdc) target directory. Cursor has no global rules dir; point it at a project's .cursor/rules. Empty = ~/.cursor/rules. | Cursor 的 Skill（.mdc）应用目录。留空时使用 ~/.cursor/rules。
_codex_home: Codex CLI home, default ~/.codex (sessions in sessions/, Skills in prompts/). Usually no need to change. | Codex CLI 根目录。通常无需修改。
_llm_provider: LLM backend for distill and reports: auto (default) | claude | aime (ByteDance AIME, with bytedcli) | mira (HTTP gateway). Falls back to aime if claude is unavailable. | 蒸馏与周报使用的 LLM 后端。无 claude 时自动切换至 aime。
_mira: Optional: use a Mira / ModelHub OpenAI-compatible gateway as the LLM backend. Set mira_endpoint (chat/completions URL) to enable; mira_token is the Bearer, mira_model the model name. | 可选：将 Mira / ModelHub 网关作为 LLM 后端。
_lark_user_id: Feishu open_id (starts with ou_), the DM recipient for retro / weekly. Empty = auto-detect current user; DM disabled if detection fails. | 飞书 DM 收件人。留空时自动探测当前用户。
_weekly_doc_url: Weekly report Lark document URL; weekly_update --approve appends each new week here. Empty = created on first --approve. | 周报 Lark 文档 URL。留空时首次 --approve 自动创建。
_tracked_people: People listed separately under dev follow-ups in the report, e.g. ["Alice", "Bob"]. Empty = section omitted. | 周报中单列开发跟进的人员。留空时不输出该节。
_meeting_savings: Time-saved estimate (minutes) per meeting whose action items are auto-delivered: manual effort saved (saved) and automation overhead (overhead). Used only for the Dashboard estimate; calibrate to your own. | 省时估算口径（分钟），仅用于 Dashboard 的估算项，可按实际校准。
_cursor_enabled: Include Cursor sessions in observation: auto (default, enabled if detected) | false (off). | 是否将 Cursor 会话并入观察。
_cursor_storage_dir: Cursor User directory (containing globalStorage/state.vscdb). Empty = located by platform default. | Cursor 的 User 目录。留空时按平台默认位置查找。
_cli_paths: Absolute paths to the three CLIs. Empty = auto-detect via PATH (which); set only for non-standard install locations. | 三个 CLI 的绝对路径。留空时通过 PATH 自动探测。
_claude_projects_dir: Claude Code sessions directory, default ~/.claude/projects. Usually no need to change. | Claude Code 会话目录。通常无需修改。
_meeting_state_file: Optional: meeting-actions state/processed.json, to merge in meeting data. Empty = ignored. | 可选：meeting-actions 的会议数据。留空则忽略。
